patterns.note: Sections alternate between a dark brand blue background and a light background to create visual segmentation and rhythm down the page.
Information is frequently presented in digestible card-like structures or icon-accompanied lists, especially for feature overviews and service offerings.

A strong, consistent dark blue serves as the primary brand color, providing a professional and trustworthy foundation, contrasted with a bright orange accent for calls to action and key financial figures.
A clean, sans-serif typeface is used consistently across all text, with clear hierarchy established through variations in size and weight for headings, body text, and labels.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to key site sections.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, ensuring it remains visible and accessible at the top of the screen throughout the user's scroll journey.

Content sections primarily reveal by scrolling into view from the bottom, without complex scroll-triggered reveal animations or parallax effects. Subtle CSS keyframe animations may be employed for micro-interactions or element entrances not captured in the scroll sequence.
Visual emphasis on key financial figures and calls to action is achieved by rendering them in a vibrant accent color against the dominant brand palette.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear hierarchy with bold, larger headings (approx 2-3x body text) and a consistent, readable body text size.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approx 4-8px) on buttons, image corners, and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density; hero is airy, feature grids are well-spaced, footer is dense.

standout: The site effectively uses a strong, consistent dark blue brand color to establish a sense of trust and professionalism, contrasting it with a bright orange accent for key financial figures and calls to action, which helps guide user attention and highlights critical information.
